answer: Each epoch opens 40 ridge posts. Applicants seal a bid; top 40 win, each paying the highest losing bid, near 50. Winners post a 30-credit bond, then wander their ridge route and file a zenith reading at midday; a miss burns the bond. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 in bids plus 30,000 bonded, 80,000 against a 40,000 pool over 25 epochs. A rented-bid ring fails: route and reading bind to one key. An honest agent bids once and reclaims its bond.
